FILE.ROLE: epoll level-triggered reactor: accepts peers, dispatches bounded read and write pumps under explicit readiness and state preconditions, re-synchronizes interest masks so queued output reaches idle recipients, reaps finished sessions and exits cleanly on a stop flag.

DATA.NAME: struct loop
DATA.ROLE: Opaque reactor instance; definition is private to src/loop.c

INTERFACE.NAME: loop_create
INTERFACE.ROLE: Create an epoll reactor bound to a broker

INTERFACE.NAME: loop_add_listener
INTERFACE.ROLE: Register the listener for EPOLLIN with data pointer NULL

INTERFACE.NAME: loop_run
INTERFACE.ROLE: Run the readiness loop until stopped or fatal

INTERFACE.NAME: loop_destroy
INTERFACE.ROLE: Close the epoll descriptor and free the loop

DATA.NAME: LOOP_READ_CHUNK
DATA.ROLE: stack staging chunk size for recv

DATA.NAME: LOOP_MAX_READ_CALLS
DATA.ROLE: Bounded read calls per descriptor per dispatched event

DATA.NAME: LOOP_MAX_WRITE_CALLS
DATA.ROLE: Bounded write calls per descriptor per dispatched event

DATA.NAME: LOOP_ACCEPT_BURST
DATA.ROLE: Bounded accepted peers per listener event

DATA.NAME: LOOP_WAIT_MS
DATA.ROLE: epoll_wait timeout so the stop flag is observed without a signal

DATA.NAME: struct loop
DATA.ROLE: Private reactor state: epoll descriptor, borrowed broker, borrowed listener and stop flag

FIELDS.NAME: stop_flag
FIELDS.ROLE: Optional signal-written flag; NULL when unset

FIELDS.NAME: stopped
FIELDS.ROLE: Internal stop request set by loop_stop

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static int is_registered(const struct loop *l, const struct session *s)
INTERFACE.NAME: is_registered
INTERFACE.ROLE: Guard against dispatching an event for a session that was already reaped

INTERFACE.NAME: accept_ready
INTERFACE.ROLE: Bounded accept loop adopting peers through broker_accept, keeping the listener on EMFILE

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static void pump_read(struct loop *l, struct session *s)
INTERFACE.NAME: pump_read
INTERFACE.ROLE: Bounded nonblocking reads into the session input buffer followed by broker_process_input

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static void pump_write(struct loop *l, struct session *s)
INTERFACE.NAME: pump_write
INTERFACE.ROLE: Bounded nonblocking writes draining the session output buffer

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static void dispatch_event(struct loop *l, struct session *s, uint32_t events)
INTERFACE.NAME: dispatch_event
INTERFACE.ROLE: Apply the readiness preconditions that select read and/or write pumping

INTERFACE.NAME: mask_sync
INTERFACE.ROLE: Recompute and apply each session interest mask from its state and queued output

INTERFACE.NAME: loop_create
INTERFACE.ROLE: Allocate the loop and create the epoll descriptor

INTERFACE.NAME: loop_add_listener
INTERFACE.ROLE: epoll_ctl ADD of the listener for EPOLLIN with data pointer NULL

INTERFACE.NAME: loop_set_stop_flag
INTERFACE.ROLE: Store the borrowed stop flag pointer

INTERFACE.NAME: loop_run
INTERFACE.ROLE: epoll_wait batch loop: dispatch events, reap, synchronize masks, honour the stop flag

INTERFACE.NAME: loop_destroy
INTERFACE.ROLE: Close epfd if open and free the loop object
